messages:
mona: Hit a weird one while rotating creds on Windows service: app didn't pick up new REDWOOD_API_KEY until restart.
kevin: Windows service envs are tricky. Did the rotate tool update the creds file or env?
mona: It wrote %USERPROFILE%\\.redwood\\creds.json and exported the user env, but the service runs as machine account so env change wasn't visible. SDK also didn't detect file change.
ash: We've seen this. Current SDKs often read env/file at init and cache to avoid KMS calls. For long-running services we need explicit refresh hooks.
kevin: Proposal: default behavior = check REDWOOD_API_KEY on each request with a tiny TTL cache (1-2s). File-based creds = watch mode with mtime+short sha1 prefix check. Add REDWOOD_CRED_HOTRELOAD env to opt-out.
mona: That sounds reasonable. For Windows, can we support named-pipe refresh hooks so a deploy agent can signal the service to reload creds without restart?
ash: Yes. Add REDWOOD_CRED_HOOK_SOCKET or REDWOOD_CRED_HOOK_PIPE to configure a local control socket/pipe. If set, SDK listens for a "refresh" message and forces refresh immediately.
kevin: API surface: expose Client.refreshCredentials(force=false) and an event client.on('cred-switched', cb). Also ensure retries after 401 re-fetch credentials before retrying. Parity: python already does this; make js/go match.
mona: Important invariant: REDWOOD_PROJECT_ID and REDWOOD_ORG_ID must be init-only. If those envs change at runtime, SDK should log an error and refuse to switch routing.
ash: Agreed. Add a clear log line when source switches (env->file->kms) and a metric cred_source_switch_total. Keep logs low-volume.
kevin: Sample Windows PowerShell snippet for deployments: ```powershell
# rotate-windows.ps1
Set-Content -Path $env:USERPROFILE\\.redwood\\creds.json -Value '{"api_key":"NEW"}'
# if service supports hook pipe:
"refresh" | Out-File -FilePath \\\.
pipe\\redwood_refresh -Encoding ascii
```
mona: Nice. I'll try a manual named-pipe refresh against the service. If hook not configured, docs should say: update secret and restart service or use service-specific signal.
infra-bot: PR preview: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-specs/pull/58 - cred hot-reload, hook pipe, init-only project/org policy, retry-on-401 refresh (CI: pending)
eng-sdk: We'll prototype hook support and add REDWOOD_CRED_WATCH_MODE options (auto|poll|none). Will also add integration test rotate-service-windows.ps1 to flaky-tests.
mona: thanks all. tagging @eng-sdk and leaving logs here after I test. :thumbsup:
